title: From multi-omics discovery to experimental validation: GPC4 mediates the anti-neuroinflammatory effects of Buyang Huanwu decoction via TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling in ischemic stroke with Qi deficiency and blood stasis syndrome.
authors: Zhang, Chenxing; Wu, Xinyu; Yu, Zhexuan; Xu, Guanfeng; Yang, Jiehong; Shao, Chongyu; Wan, Haitong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药补阳还五汤通过GPC4/TLR4/NF-kB通路抗缺血性卒中神经炎症，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药物机制与湿实验验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Buyang Huanwu Decoction (BYHW) is a classical Chinese herbal formula derived from Wang Qingren's "Medical Forest Corrections" during the Qing Dynasty. Research has consistently demonstrated that BYHW possesses substantial traditional usage evidence as an ethnic medicine for treating ischemic stroke (IS) with Qi deficiency and blood stasis (QDBS) Syndrome. AIM OF THE STUDY: Identifying key differentially expressed proteins in BYHW treatment for IS with QDBS Syndrome and its anti-neuroinflammatory mechanism of action. MATERIALS AND METHODS: An IS with QDBS Syndrome rat model was established using a combination of fasting, weight-bearing swimming, and MCAO/R. BYHW efficacy was evaluated through neurological function scoring, TTC staining, histopathology, blood rheology, and coagulation function assessment. Integrated proteomics, transcriptomics, and network pharmacology screened key targets and pathways, validated through molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, Western blot, RT-qPCR, and immunofluorescence. Furthermore, knockdown of GPC4 using siRNA demonstrated its involvement in the regulation of the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. RESULTS: BYHW effectively improved neurological deficits, reduced infarct size, corrected blood rheology abnormalities, and restored coagulation function in model rats. Multi-omics integration analysis identified GPC4 as a key differentially expressed protein, consistently pointing to the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Mechanistic studies revealed co-expressed of GPC4 and TLR4 in astrocytes. BYHW significantly suppressed GPC4 and TLR4 expression as well as NF-kappaB phosphorylation, thereby downregulating the transcription and protein levels of downstream pro-inflammatory factors TNF-alpha and IL-1beta. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations suggested that the active components of BYHW (Calycosin, calycosin-7-glucoside, formononetin, Ononin, and Paeoniflorin) exhibit strong binding affinity with GPC4. Moreover, knockdown of GPC4 suppressed the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway and reversed the pro-inflammatory effects, establishing that the therapeutic action of BYHW is mediated through this axis. CONCLUSIONS: This study first identifies GPC4 as a key differentially expressed protein in IS with QDBS Syndrome and reveals that BYHW alleviates neuroinflammation by targeting the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling axis, providing scientific rationale for its clinical application.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：补阳还五汤（BYHW）是源自清代王清任《医林改错》的经典中药复方。研究一致表明，BYHW作为治疗气虚血瘀（QDBS）证缺血性卒中（IS）的民族药物，具有大量传统使用证据。研究目的：鉴定BYHW治疗气虚血瘀证IS中的关键差异表达蛋白及其抗神经炎症作用机制。材料与方法：采用禁食、负重游泳和MCAO/R相结合的方法建立气虚血瘀证IS大鼠模型。通过神经功能评分、TTC染色、组织病理学、血液流变学和凝血功能评估评价BYHW疗效。整合蛋白质组学、转录组学和网络药理学筛选关键靶点和通路，并通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、Western blot、RT-qPCR和免疫荧光进行验证。此外，使用siRNA敲低GPC4证明其参与TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路的调控。结果：BYHW有效改善模型大鼠的神经功能缺损、减少梗死面积、纠正血液流变学异常并恢复凝血功能。多组学整合分析鉴定GPC4为关键差异表达蛋白，一致指向TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路。机制研究表明GPC4和TLR4在星形胶质细胞中共表达。BYHW显著抑制GPC4和TLR4表达以及NF-kappaB磷酸化，从而下调下游促炎因子TNF-alpha和IL-1beta的转录和蛋白水平。分子对接和分子动力学模拟提示BYHW的活性成分（毛蕊异黄酮、毛蕊异黄酮-7-葡萄糖苷、芒柄花素、芒柄花苷和芍药苷）与GPC4表现出强结合亲和力。此外，敲低GPC4抑制TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路并逆转促炎效应，证实BYHW的治疗作用通过该轴介导。结论：本研究首次鉴定GPC4为气虚血瘀证IS中的关键差异表达蛋白，并揭示BYHW通过靶向TLR4/NF-kappaB信号轴减轻神经炎症，为其临床应用提供科学依据。
